## IntegerHelpers.validate() method

Return `value` as an [Integer](./contracts.integer.md)<!-- -->, or throw if it is not one.

**Signature:**

```typescript
validate(value: number): Integer;
```

**Returns:**

[Integer](./contracts.integer.md)

## Exceptions

`RangeError` when `value` is not finite, not integral, or outside [INTEGER_LIMITS](./contracts.integer_limits.md)<!-- -->; the message says which and names the explicit conversions. `TypeError` when `value` is not a number at all.

## Remarks

Nothing is rounded or truncated: a fractional number is rejected. `-0` becomes `0`<!-- -->.
